name: Northgate 3: Send Email
description: CV screening (project 10): sends an email with Gmail in live mode, or writes it to the Northgate Outbox table in test mode.

parameters.content:
## Northgate 3: Send Email
Every email to applicants and the recruiter goes through here. With `mode = live` in **Northgate Settings** it sends with Gmail; in test mode it writes to the **Northgate Outbox** table instead, so the whole pipeline can be tested without emailing anyone.
